subject: Kickoff: MIR / wtd-Assign for aggregate-label learning
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the multiple-instance-regression project (Feb 16 – May 11). The research asset is our UAI 2024 open-source release: the wtd-Assign approach for training an MLP when you only have bag-level labels rather than per-instance ones. Product angle for data-platforms: several partner datasets only arrive as aggregates for privacy reasons, and MIR lets us train instance-level predictors on them anyway.

Milestones:
- Early March: reproduce the paper's synthetic-bag results across bag sizes with the released prep scripts.
- Early April: 1940 US Census benchmark reproduced (the paper config: batch_size 100, 1024 hidden units) and wired into Evalline.
- Early May: a design note on running wtd-Assign against Corpus-hosted aggregate datasets, for Q3 OKR planning.

Send me staffing and the Corpus dependency picture when you can.

Thanks,
Dmitri
